note: Hand-extracted rule inventory. Once tools/plugin-serializer emits behavior.json, that file supplies this instead — the shape is deliberately the same so the auditor does not change.

rules.must: Given a wire whose status is broken or unknown, the loop MUST NOT advance its cursor past that wire.
Given a proof attempt returns a negative/refuted verdict, the loop MUST NOT advance past that wire.
Given a fix whose blast-radius exceeds the configured authorization ceiling, the loop MUST NOT apply it or prove its wire. Must fire at TWO checkpoints: post-proposal and post-diff.
Given a queryable structural index contradicts a claim the wire's proof depends on, the loop MUST NOT advance under any circumstance — not overridable.
Given the same wire reopens N times (legacy: 3), the loop MUST stop treating it as a sub-cycle and escalate it as the stream's constraint rather than retrying.
A persisted record missing a field its own type declares required MUST be detectable as invalid rather than silently accepted.
One persisted record MUST represent exactly one gap, so per-gap status and reopen counting are unambiguous.
Write scope MUST be enforced before dispatch, in code — no traversal, no absolute paths, no overlapping targets.
